Hi Amit — great to connect. 60 minutes should work; I recommend a single session with a tight agenda so we can close open clarifications and list evidence owners. Proposed agenda:

- 5m: Introductions and scope (what HarborTech needs from SIG vs SOC2)
- 15m: CAIQ question walk (we'll flag answers that need evidence)
- 20m: Evidence inventory & owner assignment (who can deliver docs)
- 15m: Next steps, evidence handoff method, timelines
- 5m: Buffer/quick follow-ups

I can do Tue 10/6 at 9:30 PT. If that works, I will send a calendar invite with a shared Drive folder and a short action tracker.

Quick note on evidence we can provide during the call: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (SOC 2 in-scope controls and last attestation), redwood_network_diagram_v2.pdf (high level), and a dataflow PNG. I'll attach the SOC2 summary now so your team can scan it beforehand.

If you prefer two calls, we can split CAIQ + evidence handoff — but most customers prefer one targeted hour.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Stephanie — 9:30 PT Tue 10/6 works for us. Priya from Procurement is joining to kick off evidence logistics.

A couple of clarifications from our side prior to the call:
- We typically ask for a copy of the most recent SOC 2 report (redacted ok) or a SOC 2 attestation letter.
- For network diagrams, we want a diagram that indicates segmentation between customer data plane and management plane (a high-level PNG is fine).
- Do you have a standard evidence handoff method (S3, secure Drive link, or email)? We prefer S3 presigned links or a secure drive.

I've attached the CSV with our full question set so you can pre-label answers during the call if possible.

Thanks,
Amit
